content.short: Sanctum is a liquid staking layer on Solana that unifies LST liquidity via the multi-asset Infinity Pool.
content.description:
Sanctum is a pioneering decentralized protocol built natively on the Solana blockchain, designed to solve the problem of fragmented liquidity within the liquid staking ecosystem. The platform features the "Infinity Pool," a multi-asset liquidity layer that allows users to deposit any Solana-based Liquid Staking Token (LST) to receive INF, a highly composable asset representing a diversified basket of staking rewards. This approach ensures that users can maximize their yields while maintaining deep liquidity for use across the broader Solana DeFi landscape.

Powered by the $CLOUD token, Sanctum provides innovative financial tools such as "Wonderland," a gamified loyalty program that incentivizes long-term participation through interactive digital pets. The protocol also offers an instant unstake feature, allowing participants to convert their staked assets back to liquid SOL without the typical cooldown periods. Through its focus on user-centric design and technological innovation, Sanctum has become a foundational pillar of the Solana network, empowering participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios with institutional-grade precision.
content.meta: Sanctum provides unified liquid staking and high-efficiency liquidity pools for the Solana blockchain.
